name: How long does it take to see results from AEO for a pediatric practice?
description: Practices typically see AEO results within 3-6 months, with more significant impact on patient acquisition within 6-12 months. It is a long-term strategy.

mainEntity.name: How long does it take to see results from AEO for a pediatric practice?

acceptedAnswer.text: The timeframe to see significant results from AEO efforts can vary, but generally, practices start observing improvements in online visibility and organic traffic within 3 to 6 months. More substantial impacts on patient acquisition and ranking increases often become apparent over 6 to 12 months. AEO is a long-term strategy, and consistent effort combined with AI-driven adjustments leads to sustainable growth rather than instant results.
